messages:
alex: spotted a small spike in provisional tokens around 03:21 UTC on eu-west during a model-swap. provisional moved up but confirmed didn't follow for ~12 minutes on several sessions.
mina: any logs? could be the usual prefix-ownership thing or a new edge because of toolcall truncation.
alex: here's an anonymized session trace: 
```
2026-03-24T03:20:58Z session=zz111 event=handoff.start provisional=80 model_swap=stable->fast
2026-03-24T03:20:59Z session=zz111 event=stream.chunk truncated=true
2026-03-24T03:21:00Z session=zz111 event=client.retry reason=timeout new_session=zz111-1
# no handoff.finish for original handoff id
```
frank: so provisional allocated at handoff.start, then retry creates a new session and router allocates provisional again. if neither handoff.finish nor confirm occur, we get stacked provisional rows.
tara: is the router dedupe using any provenance header? we added x-replay-id in some clients but not all.
mina: looks like the failing clients didn't set x-replay-id. we should make router resilient without client changes.
alex: quick telemetry query i used: 
```
select route, count() as sessions_with_orphans from tokens_events
where event_time > now() - interval '1 hour' and event='provisional_alloc'
and session not in (select session from tokens_events where event='confirmed_write' and event_time > now()-interval '1 hour')
group by route order by sessions_with_orphans desc
```
frank: short-term mitigations: (A) ledger sweep to reconcile provisional entries older than 10m when a matching confirmed_write exists; (B) emit reconciliation marker in router when forced confirmed_write occurs during fallback; (C) short metric alert provisional > confirmed delta > 500 tokens for > 2m.
tara: UI ask: add a lightweight "provisional delta" sparkline per-route and a link to sample traces in Console. ops keep getting paged without context.
emina: (minor) typo: i'm mina not emina
mina: lol corrected. also i'll open the telemetry schema PR to add tokens.provisional_state label with values started/confirmed/orphaned. that will make dashboards much clearer.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-04 opened: "Provisional token drift during model-swap + retry"
telemetry-bot: queued pipeline: telemetry-schema-PR-77, will run integration tests and lint.
alex: i'll run a targeted sweep on the affected routes tonight and post before/after numbers. frank, can you draft a router patch to emit reconciliation marker on fallback?
frank: will do a small patch; plan: add `router.reconcile_hint{session,hand off_id}` emission whenever router performs forced confirmed_write, and add server-side dedupe on recent handoff ids within 15s.
tara: rollout plan: patch + telemetry change -> canary on eu-west for 30m, monitor provisional/confirmed delta and errors, then widen.
alex: thanks all. i'll attach a couple sample traces to INC-2026-04 and close the loop when sweep completes.
